title: For ports that are administratively up and belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e
question: For ports that are administratively up and belong to tenant ID `98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57`, list the port ID, host, VIF type, VNIC type, tenant ID, network ID, MAC address, status, device owner, and the average standard attribute ID computed over a window of 2 preceding and 2 following rows (partitioned by VIF type and ordered by standard attribute ID), along with the variance of standard attribute ID for that same port status among ports that have an IP allocation with IP address `10.150.64.113/8`. Do not return any rounded answers.

    p.tenant_id,

    p.mac_address,
    p.status,
